text:
marie: Quick heads-up from the observability dashboard pass. Found a few a11y nits that block keyboard & screen reader flows. Summary: warning chips ~3.7:1 contrast at 12px, top header links have no :focus-visible in Chrome (we're suppressing outline), side panel trap when toggling filters, and table headers missing aria-sort labels.

jon: thanks! can you drop exact repro steps and browsers?

marie: repro: mac Chrome 114 + VoiceOver, also tested Windows Chrome+NVDA. Steps: 1) open dashboard -> Notifications panel -> tab to top nav; 2) hit tab until you get to header links (they receive focus but no visible ring); 3) open left filters panel, tab through, tab again and focus jumps to main content behind the panel; 4) in the Projects table try to activate sort, NVDA doesn't announce column sort state.

sam: modal/side-panel traps usually mean our focus-lock lib isn't catching nodes created dynamically (we mount filter buttons after animation). For now we can add inert on the background container when panel is open and explicitly focus the first focusable element inside the panel on open.

olivia: i can reproduce the double announce on alert banners too: VO reads full banner then repeats because banner has role=alert and its parent container has aria-live. we should standardize to one live-region pattern. Also adding small e2e checks for keyboard tab order would catch regressions.

jon: on the outline issue i'm pretty sure a global reset is doing outline: none on all elements. We should target only when we replace with focus-visible and ensure high-contrast token usage. Proposed CSS: 
```css
:focus { outline: none; } /* avoid global in reset */
:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--intent-focus); border-radius: 4px; }
```
but we need to use token var(--a11y-focus-strong) set to a recommended color that meets 4.5:1 against our background.

marie: for the warning chip color, using #FFB84D (current) on 12px fails. If we keep the same hue we should increase weight or add a 1px stroke to improve contrast. Alternatively swap to token --status-warning-strong.

a11y-bot: scan results (axe v4): violations => color-contrast x3 (chips & footer links), focus-visible absent x1, aria-allowed-attr x1, table-headers-not-labelled x1. Guidance: use dedicated live region, ensure focus-visible present, and provide aria-sort on sortable headers.

sam: action items: (1) jon - remove global outline none and add focus-visible token (PR), (2) jon - change warning chip token to --status-warning-strong or add 1px border, (3) olivia - add a test that toggles panel and tabs through to assert focus stays inside, (4) marie - update figma tokens and annotate the table header components with aria-sort patterns.

john: aiming to ship quick fix for focus & panel trap in next patch. will write repros in PR.

olivia: i'll run NVDA/VoiceOver checks on the PR preview and report back.

marie: thanks all, small polish but high impact. adding these to the sprint board under "a11y quick wins". :sparkles:
